preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of edges m must be at least 1 and at most n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.
Each output integer must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) <= n - 1 for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output integer must not exceed n - 1.
